what_area_is_about: component readability with combined query state
key_ideas: Dependent queries are useful when one query needs data from another.
Dependent queries can create serial loading.
Independent resources should be fetched in parallel.
Multiple useQuery calls give each query its own cache and lifecycle.
useQueries can run multiple query configs and can be dynamic.
combine can derive one combined result from multiple query states.
A combined custom hook can make the consuming component easier to read.

limitations: S-126 and S-140 are split parts of one example
